## Detailed geometry in Windows 0.24.27

With the verified Hunyuan3D 2.1 shape model installed, Create uses a 768-pixel reference and reconstructs the solid geometry using 30 diffusion steps. TripoSR provides an initial color estimate. The detailed surface is extracted from the shape network and compacted using a local plane fit. A triangle depth buffer fits the front photograph to recessed features. The left, right and back image guides use the detailed shape’s normals and render at 768 pixels. Generated models remain self-contained GLBs.

Compatible workspaces show a one-time 6.9 GiB download in 3D Studio. It uses the existing local ComfyUI video runtime and verifies the pinned checkpoint before installation and use. Interrupted transfers resume if the server supports ranges. Workspaces with only the original 3D runtime continue to use TripoSR. Setup requires a connection to download the weights. Generation runs locally.

Model and license information are available from [Tencent](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1). The optional download uses the [Comfy-Org checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/hunyuan3D_2.1_repackaged).

## Detailed geometry, Windows 0.24.27

Reconstructed the blue ceramic owl using the front image embedded in the 0.24.26 export. Comparing the meshes without textures at four fixed angles showed separate toes, a defined beak, eye sockets and wing contours. The earlier mesh showed irregular ridges across the head and wings. The new mesh uses 98,574 triangles in the matched-reference comparison. It retains generated color detail around the back. Unseen surfaces are still estimates.

An early trial picked up black padding around the extracted photo as an object. Re-segmenting the subject produced a solid sculpture. The pipeline now also checks for rectangular segmentation against black letterboxing, collapsed shapes and thin floor artifacts outside the reference silhouette.

A fresh packaged Create run on an RTX 3060 took 146.0 seconds from submission through reading the saved preview. The saved record identifies Hunyuan3D 2.1, with 99,163 triangles, four embedded textures and a 4,143,012-byte GLB. The previous 0.24.26 owl run took 51.4 seconds with a different seed. Verified orbit, export fingerprint, replay, navigation during generation and model history. Tested the downloader’s range resume, existing-file reuse and corrupted-checkpoint rejection with a small deterministic fixture. Verified the actual downloaded checkpoint’s 7,365,943,290-byte length and SHA-256.
